In the background, partially visible human legs and feet (wearing dark pants and shoes) are standing in shallow water or wet sand. The lighting suggests daylight. The shark's body appears pale/whitish, likely due to being dead and exposed, contrasting with the typical grey/brown dorsal coloration of live specimens.

The human legs/shoes in the background appear distorted and structurally ambiguous. The shoe shape is blobby and lacks clear laces/sole definition, typical of AI struggling with complex background objects.
